english.note: Use 大寫字母 when you want to be especially explicit or are discussing letters in a more formal or instructional context.

examples.english: When filling out official documents, each word in an English name should begin with a capital letter.
examples.traditional: 填寫正式文件時，英文姓名嘅每個字都要用大寫字母開頭。
